text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 350 mm of 16 x 16 x 1.5 mm square tube; square and deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seven locking pin holes, 6.5 mm, through the top and bottom walls,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 mm apart, the first 20 mm from the plain end (20 to 140 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Press a 16 x 16 tube insert with an M10 nut into the far end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: slide into the outer tube; choose the hole that sets the bar

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: about 20 mm short of the neck width, fit the pin and R-clip,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: then wind the feet out to take up the last 20 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: With the 7 holes and about 30 mm of foot travel the bar spans

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: necks of about 570 to 710 mm (600 mm as drawn, hole 6 of 7).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the pin drops through both tubes at every hole.
